let state: string | number = "initial";
class CaptureFields {
  static field = state;
  readonly field = state;
}
state = 1;
const item = new CaptureFields();
if (typeof item.field === "number") console.log(item.field.toFixed(1));
if (typeof CaptureFields.field === "string") console.log(CaptureFields.field.toUpperCase());

function declared(value = state) { console.log(value); }
const arrow = (value = state) => console.log(value);
const object = { method(value = state) { console.log(value); } };
declared("declared");
arrow("arrow");
object.method("method");

function nested(flag: boolean) {
  let local: string | number = flag ? "local" : 0;
  if (typeof local !== "string") return;
  const read = (value = local) => value.toUpperCase();
  const test = { read(value = local) { return value.toUpperCase(); } };
  console.log(read(), test.read());
}
nested(true);

let immediateValue: string | number = "before";
console.log(((ignored, value = immediateValue) => value.toFixed(1))((immediateValue = 3)));

function ordered(first: number = 4, second = first, { third = second } = {}) {
  return third.toFixed(1);
}
console.log(ordered());
